# TenderCrest AI

> TenderCrest AI helps proposal teams answer RFPs from evidence they already trust. It shreds a solicitation into a numbered requirement list, maps approved company evidence to each requirement, builds a compliance matrix, and drafts a proposal for human review. Exports to DOCX and PDF.

## Product

- [TenderCrest AI](https://www.tendercrestai.com/): Evidence-backed RFP and proposal software.
- [Product](https://www.tendercrestai.com/product.html): How the workflow works, from shredding to a reviewed proposal package.
- [Pricing](https://www.tendercrestai.com/pricing): Pro $299/month (5 proposals), Growth $699/month (20 proposals), Enterprise $1,299/month (60 proposals). Month-to-month, 14-day trial. Grant plans: Grant Starter $19/month (1 grant), Grant Plus $49/month (5 grants), Grant Pro $99/month (15 grants), each with a 14-day trial.
- [Grant Mode](https://www.tendercrestai.com/pricing#grants): NOFO shredding into a requirements checklist, evidence checking with citations, English and Spanish drafting, and compliance-matrix export for grant proposals. Federal grant opportunities: [Grants.gov feed](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/grants).
- [Interactive demo](https://www.tendercrestai.com/demo.html): Try the product with no signup.
- [Security](https://www.tendercrestai.com/security.html): How TenderCrest AI handles your documents and data.

## Free tools

- [Free RFP shredder](https://www.tendercrestai.com/tools/shredder): Paste or upload a solicitation and get a numbered requirement list. No signup, email, or card.
- [Bid-fit checker](https://www.tendercrestai.com/tools/bid-check): Score whether a solicitation is worth bidding on. No signup, email, or card.
- [Opportunity feeds](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities): Free, searchable government solicitation feeds. No signup, email, or card.

## Opportunity feeds

- [Federal solicitations, SAM.gov](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities): Live federal solicitations, searchable by keyword, NAICS, PSC, and set-aside.
- [New York City](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/nyc): Notices from the NYC City Record.
- [Federal grants](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/grants): Federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov.
- [Los Angeles](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/los-angeles): City of Los Angeles solicitations from RAMP.
- [Delaware](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/delaware): Delaware open bids.
- [Montgomery County, MD](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/montgomery-county): Montgomery County solicitations.
- [Washington, DC](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/dc): District of Columbia solicitations from PASS.
- [Washington State](https://www.tendercrestai.com/opportunities/washington): Washington State solicitations from WEBS.
